summary: Extension packages ship end-user documentation: docs/<locale>/<path>.md with front matter is validated at check/build (source-located diagnostics), carried in the version artifact and manifest (covered by the review hashes), re-validated in Go at publish and activation, and served from the active version in the Help Center under Applications (/help/doc/apps/<namespace>/...) to the readers who can use the package; helpHref in @iota-uz/sdk/runtime/client links to it and the MCP tool ext_docs reads it.
